summary.text: Patty Mueller is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 23B, with a tenure beginning in 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Mueller is a teacher with an Ed.D. in educational leadership.

paragraphs.text: Patty Mueller, listed by Ballotpedia as Patricia Mueller, lives in Austin, Minnesota, and graduated from Tartan High School in 1999.

She earned a B.S. in English education from Winona State University in 2003, an M.S. in curriculum and instruction literacy from Minnesota State University at Moorhead in 2018, and an Ed.D. in educational leadership from the same university in 2022.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher.
Ballotpedia lists Mueller's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2021, and says she assumed office in District 23B on January 3, 2023.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Education Policy (as co-vice chair), Education Finance, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees.
